links.explanation: Both reports highlight inadequate training of doctors and other medical professionals regarding eating disorders, particularly concerning the MARSIPAN guidance.
links.earlier_quote: Evidence from a wide range of clinicians who had engaged with Averil in 2012 echoed the evidence of clinicians attending the four inquests of the women referred to above.
links.later_quote: Of those, only one had knowledge of MARSIPAN and his understanding of MARSIPAN was extremely limited.
